title: Maryland and adjoining-state OpenStreetMap motor-road graph
transformation: Six raw PBF files (Maryland, Pennsylvania, Virginia, West Virginia, Delaware, District of Columbia) pinned individually in roads-manifest.json. Keep motor roads; obey motor access and one-way tags, shared OSM-node junctions, 17 km county buffers, Census internal points snapped within 500 m. Distances approximate motor-road proximity; no turn restrictions or travel time. The source hash here identifies the canonical parent-file hash list, not one PBF.
